threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused about the 24-hour bus service and assume every train might actually run on time.
Caught a night bus last Saturday; a guy in a bright pink suit proposed to a tree at Windrush Square, convinced it was his soulmate. Classic Brixton!

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I saw an old man arguing with a pigeon over a pretzel near the park, I knew this was home. Only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin can you find a spontaneous silent disco in a random park on a Tuesday afternoon. Just grab some headphones and dance! It's surreal.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here when they roll their eyes at tourists taking photos of the murals but light up when a local asks about their favorite taqueria.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a bus at Civic Center yesterday—driver stopped for ten minutes to let a tourist take selfies with their dog on the steps. Classic San Francisco.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think they can just take a Fanta to any park. Nope! You’ll get weird looks at places like plaça del Sol. Only locals know the unwritten rules.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their bewilderment at how the bus can't fit through the narrow streets—locals just know better than to try.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still look confused at the bus stops when they come late. Locals just check their phones and carry on like it’s part of the charm.
Caught the 36 last night; two blokes in matching tracksuits debating the best chicken shop in Peckham all the way to Clapham. Pure local rivalry.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I saw my neighbor fixing his bike on the sidewalk with a cat perched on his shoulder and a loud debate about soccer in the background.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do we have Kiosks selling everything from currywurst to craft beer at 3 AM, while the U-Bahn is still on strike.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot the locals by their calm in BART delays; it’s like we’re all in on the joke while newcomers panic over a loud bang.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Only in SF do you witness a dog casually saunter onto the Civic Center tracks, causing an hour delay, while locals shrug and snap photos.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think we all party until dawn. Meanwhile, most locals are at home by 11, enjoying a quiet night after a long day.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: They always stand in front of the Cathedral with a guidebook, taking photos of every statue like it's a once-in-a-lifetime moment.
